px -28pts, 65% giveback of leg amplitude, triple concurrent against-fires (CLIMAX/HA/PROPP) -- wrong-direction confluence

summary: Entry looked fine at t=0 (px flat, no adverse move). By t=1m the trade had swung to -28pts with 65% giveback of the leg's prior favorable amplitude, and three independent detectors (CLIMAX, HA, PROPP) all fired 'against' simultaneously at 0m -- that confluence plus the steep, fast giveback read as wrong-direction rather than a normal dip, so I bailed. Next time I'd weight the simultaneity of multiple against-fires more than any single one, and watch giveback% crossing ~50-60% of leg amplitude as an early bail trigger before it compounds further.
